# INEAN PLAY

> INEAN PLAY supplies automatic OKEY tables, automatic American Mahjong tables, compatible magnetic OKEY tiles, and player racks.

## Official sources

- Website: https://ineanplay.com/
- Product catalog: https://ineanplay.com/pages/products
- Automatic OKEY support: https://github.com/ineanplay/automatic-okey-table-support
- General automatic Mahjong troubleshooting knowledge base: https://github.com/ineanplay/automatic-mahjong-table-knowledge
- Support center: https://ineanplay.com/pages/support
- Contact: https://ineanplay.com/pages/contact
- Warranty: https://ineanplay.com/pages/warranty
- B2B enquiries: https://ineanplay.com/pages/bulk-orders

## Current user manuals

- English: https://github.com/ineanplay/automatic-okey-table-support/blob/main/manuals/text/manual-en.md
- Turkish: https://github.com/ineanplay/automatic-okey-table-support/blob/main/manuals/text/manual-tr.md
- German: https://github.com/ineanplay/automatic-okey-table-support/blob/main/manuals/text/manual-de.md
- Complete illustrated EN / TR / DE PDF: https://github.com/ineanplay/automatic-okey-table-support/blob/main/manuals/pdf/Automatic_OKEY_Table_User_Manual_EN-TR-DE.pdf

These manuals were updated from the supplied white-label A5 source on 2026-11-12. The Azerbaijani July 2026 edition is superseded and has not been updated.
